reason: I only have Saturdays, and the zoo is free and already our thing. Between the drive, gas and $12 plus a drink each visit, I can't see paying for it when I'd get maybe four visits a month.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up. An unlimited membership doesn't pay off when I can only go on weekends, and the zoo costs nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend-only or per-visit pass for about $30 a month, or proof that it's a short drive and the Saturday mornings are calm instead of packed.
